lessons.title: Statistics as an Evidence Discipline
lessons.focus: moving from an investigative question to data, analysis, interpretation, and communication
lessons.unit_title: Statistical Problem Solving, Data Ethics & Measurement
lessons.essential: How do strong questions, trustworthy measurements, and ethical decisions turn data into defensible evidence?
lessons.project: Data Provenance, Ethics & Investigative Question Audit
lessons.application: public policy, health, education, business, environmental monitoring, journalism, and civic decision-making
lessons.p1: Give one defensible analysis step for Statistics as an Evidence Discipline.
lessons.s1: State the question and data structure, apply moving from an investigative question to data, analysis, interpretation, and communication, check assumptions or design conditions, quantify uncertainty, and interpret the result in context.
lessons.p2: Identify a common error in Statistics as an Evidence Discipline.
lessons.s2: A common error is to report a calculation without identifying the population, design, assumptions, uncertainty, context, or limits on causal and generalizing claims.
